feeds.title: Colonist Strategies Blog
feeds.description: Visit the Colonist Strategies blog for the best tips and strategy guides in playing Colonist, an online game alternative to the board game Catan! Colonist.io is a web based, free online alternative to the challenging social and strategy based board game Settlers of Catan. You take on the role of a Colonist by building settlements and expanding your territory. Colonist combines extremely simple rules with tremendously deep gameplay.

feeds.title: Catan Studio News
feeds.description: Catan Studio focuses on developing excellent Catan content - including game, story, event, and merchandise development - as well as growing, supporting and nurturing our great Catan community. Get the latest news and updates from Catan community, tournaments and more!

feeds.title: King of Catan Blog
feeds.description: 'King of Catan' is a combination of all the different online Catan tournaments hosted in the King of Catan Discord-server. King of Catan is known for having an active community, full of high-profile Catan players, like CATAN World Champions, National Champions and Premier League Champions. Learn more about CATAN game, features, updates and more!
